content.title: How to watch Angels vs. Yankees: TV channel and streaming options for April 16
content.text: The Los Angeles Angels are looking for continued power from a batter on a roll against the New York Yankees on Thursday at 1:35 p.m. ET, at Yankee Stadium. Mike Trout is currently on a three-game homer streak. Max Fried (2-0, 1.93 ERA) gets the start for the Yankees, who are 10-8 this season and second in the AL East. Brent Suter (0-1, 2.08 ERA) is expected to start for the Angels, who are 9-10 and third in the AL West.How to watch Los Angeles Angels vs. New York Yankees Venue: Yankee Stadium Time: 1:35 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: YES and FDSW Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. His OPS is 1.156, which ranks 4th in MLB, and he has scored 15 runs. In 66 plate appearances, he has hit four home runs and driven in 13 runs. Rice has been crafty on the base paths, recording one steal on one attempt. In 78 plate appearances, Aaron Judge is hitting .235/.325/.574 with a .898 OPS and three steals on four attempts. He has hit seven long balls (2nd in MLB), driven in 13 runs and scored 15 times. Los Angeles’ Trout is slashing .239/.393/.552 this season with six home runs (6th in MLB), 15 RBIs (13th in MLB) and an OPS of .945 (16th in MLB). He has a 21.4% strikeout rate and a 17.9% walk rate in 84 plate appearances, and he has scored 18 total runs. Trout has recorded two steals on two attempts. In 90 plate appearances, Zach Neto has posted a 27.8% strikeout rate and a 15.6% walk rate while slashing .240/.367/.493 with five home runs (12th in MLB), nine RBIs and 17 runs scored. He has stolen one base on two attempts.
